source: Nodebuster.pck recovered with GDRE Tools v2.6.4 (engine 4.2.2)

semantics.cost: costs[i] is the price of going from level i to i+1 (res://Scripts/Upgrades/Upgrade.gd:31-33). maxLevel = costs.length.
semantics.effects: Applied once per level bought (res://Scripts/Shop/UpgradeTree.gd:97-98; on load, per saved level: res://Scripts/Autoloads/Stores/UpgradeStore.gd:716-717). op add = stat += perLevel; op set = stat = value.
semantics.requires: Node is visible and buyable only when the rule holds, evaluated over scene neighbours. level 1 = neighbour has >= 1 level; level "max" = neighbour is maxed. mode any = OR, all = AND. requires null = always visible (root). (res://Scripts/Upgrades/UpgradeProcessor.gd:197-399, res://Scripts/Shop/UpgradeTree.gd:66-67)
semantics.position: rect = [x, y, w, h] in tree-local pixels (Control offsets, res://GameScenes/ShopScene.tscn). grid = centre relative to Damage1 in 32 px steps (x right, y down).
semantics.neighbors: Undirected edges drawn as 1 px lines in MyColors.WHITE (res://Scripts/Shop/UpgradeTree.gd:34-51).
